reply.label: Reply
reply.description: Answer them in the member's voice. Also for a holding reply that keeps the thread open (holding: true).

text.label: Reply
text.help: The answer, ready to send as written

holding.label: Holding reply
holding.help: true when it only says you are on it

reply_book.label: Reply and book
reply_book.description: Answer them and book a meeting (pick the time with calendar_free). On approval Hivenod puts the meeting in the member's calendar (source hivenod, sourceEventId = this outcome's id); you then send the reply and the invite, mirror the event to the source calendar and report outcome_done.

text.label: Reply
text.help: The answer, ready to send as written

end.label: Ends
end.help: ISO 8601 with its offset, after start

with.label: With
with.help: Who is invited: names or emails, separated by commas

title.label: Title
title.help: What the calendar shows; by default "Meeting with <with>"

no_reply.label: No reply needed
no_reply.description: Nothing to answer: an FYI, already handled, or the member answered outside Hivenod.

reason.label: Why
reason.help: One line on why no answer is needed

make_it_work.label: Make it work
make_it_work.description: It needs real work: a Hivenod item. When the item is done, propose a reply saying so.

title.label: Item title
title.help: The work, as an item title

brief.label: Brief
brief.help: What is asked, by whom, and what done looks like

handover.label: Hand over
handover.description: Loop in someone else, or another organization's agent.

snooze.label: Snooze
snooze.description: Come back to it later: the thread waits until the date, then wakes up.

nudge.label: Nudge
nudge.description: They have not answered for a while: a short reminder.

text.label: Nudge
text.help: The reminder, ready to send as written

ignore.label: Ignore
ignore.description: Not for the member: spam, noise, not theirs.
